 Birmingham Police: Multiple shot, investigation underway 
 By WBRC Digital Staff Published : Oct. 31, 2026 at 8:51 PM CDT | Updated : seconds ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BIRMINGHAM, Ala. ( WBRC ) - Birmingham Police are at an “active scene” of a shooting where they said multiple people were shot.
 Police said they can confirm that multiple people were “wounded by gunfire” near the 400 block of Graymont Avenue just after 7:50 p.m. 
 Police said officials are on the scene investigating.
 At this time, officials said the conditions of those injured are not known.
 Birmingham Police said all Magic City Classic tailgating has been suspended and are asking the public to not go near Legion Field.
 🚨PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT 🚨
All Magic City Classic tailgating has been suspended.
Everyone needs to leave the stadium property as soon as possible.
Please do not come to the Legion Field stadium property at this time.
— Bhampolice (@BhamPolice) November 1, 2026 
 This is a breaking story and will be updated as more information becomes available.
